answers.value: (a) 490 g of sulphuric acid (b) 56 L of sulphur dioxide (56000 cc)

(b) 24 g of Mg liberates 22.4 L of \(\mathrm{SO_2}\), so 60 g liberates \(y = 22.4 \times 60/24 = 56\) L (56000 cc).
